§6Elite Plating§f

§aThe top-tier plate in NuclearCraft.§f
§bElite Plating§f is crafted from §bDU Plating§f and other high-end materials. It gates access to the most powerful machines and reactor components. You won't need many of these early on, but once you're building endgame reactors and particle accelerator parts, you'll want a steady supply.

This is also the plate that gates QMD content. If you're trying to progress into QMD's tech tree and hitting a wall, check if you need more Elite Plating.

§ePS:§f Elite Plating is expensive to produce. Don't overproduce it until you know exactly what you need it for. The Assembler recipe requires DU Plating as input.
